constructions.lofted-whole: (a) as written: one Geom2d_Line edge per helix, one ruled solid BRepOffsetAPI_ThruSections between the closed helical wires on the inner and outer cylinders or cones
constructions.lofted-edge-per-turn: (a) with each helix cut into one edge per turn from the start
constructions.lofted-divided: (a) with one edge per turn, the frame turned to the thread's phase, then ShapeUpgrade_ShapeDivideAngle(2 pi) divides the faces on the cylinders or cones at every turn (an OCCT algorithm section 8.2 does not name)
constructions.swept: (b) as written: BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipeShell of the trapezoid along GeomAPI_PointsToBSpline of 32 points per turn (degrees 3 to 8, C2, 1e-4 mm), binormal mode along the axis, MakeSolid
constructions.swept-overlap: (b) with the profile's flanks run on 0.05 mm radially into the base

inputs_chosen.profile: ISO 68-1 basic profile: depth 5H/8, H = sqrt(3)/2 P, 3P/4 wide at the minor diameter and P/8 at the major, 0.2 mm radial clearance (external tooth on the basic minor radius less 0.2, internal groove on it plus 0.2); 1/4-20 UNC: D 6.35, P 1.27
inputs_chosen.placement: on a threaded length L the tooth runs from P/4 above the base's bottom to P/4 below its top (turns = L/P - 1.25), right-handed, ending at 45 degrees
inputs_chosen.rods: make_cylinder of the tooth's inner radius, height L = 20 mm (30 mm for M8 also)
inputs_chosen.blocks: square of side D + 10 mm with a bore of the groove's inner radius, extruded L
inputs_chosen.cap: internal M30 x 2, 12 mm, in a cylinder of radius 18 mm, height 14 mm, bore radius 14.1175 mm open at height 0 and 12 mm deep
inputs_chosen.neck: external M30 x 2, 12 mm, on a tube of radius 13.7175 mm around an 11 mm bore, 12 mm long
inputs_chosen.coil: (a) only: 2 mm pitch tooth on cones of half-angle 5 degrees, inner radius 10 mm at height 0, 5 turns, on the frustum over 12.5 mm; and the bare 5-turn helix
inputs_chosen.slot: 2 mm wide box (x from -1 to 1) through the part along y, from 1 mm below the base to half the threaded length, cut first
inputs_chosen.box: 0.5 mm wide along the turn, from half the depth inside the inner side to half the depth outside the outer side, P/16 beyond the end face's axial ends, one face in the end face's plane on its outside, fused second

pass_reading: section 8.2's Pass as written: the construction and the thread with its boolean valid as built, both later booleans valid (as built or after repair; a failed call is not valid), the exactness check of the construction's and the result's crest and root edges (a result without crest or root edges fails it), parity, and the M8 x 1.25 x 20 time; the volume checks (8.2's Checks) are measured, not criteria

decision: Neither construction passes every criterion of section 8.2, so the Decision's last case applies: an ADR lists the failing sizes, and features/thread.md offers a cosmetic thread in their failure message. (a) as written passes the per-input criteria on the cap and the neck only (its later booleans fail on 17 of 19 inputs) and misses the time; (a) divided per turn (ShapeUpgrade_ShapeDivideAngle, not named in 8.2) passes every per-input criterion, the size and the cap's poll gap but takes rod 416.5 ms, block 418.0 ms for M8 x 1.25 x 20 against 300 ms (median of three native sets); (b) fails parity on every input (and as written validity, the later booleans and memory), so it does not replace (a). The failing sizes for the ADR: (a) as written every size but M30 x 2 at 12 mm; (a) divided M8 x 1.25 x 20, by time alone; (b) with overlap and plain (b) every size. The ADR should settle whether the divided variant counts as (a) and whether its measured time is accepted; ADR 0071 gets no confirming note.
